summary.headline: NALCO posted record H1 FY27 results: revenue INR11,143 crore, EBITDA INR5,539 crore, PAT INR3,837 crore (H1 PAT up 54% YoY).
summary.overview: Management described H1 FY27 as the best half-yearly performance since inception on revenue, EBITDA, PBT and PAT, with Q2 net profit of INR1,835 crore up 28% YoY. Input costs rose sharply in H1 (caustic soda, CP coke, fuel oil/LDO), with power and fuel up about INR317 crore YoY, mainly from fuel oil use during coal shortages and rain-related moisture issues. Management expects H2 input costs to hold near H1 levels, with techno-economic gains and a 5th Stream refinery start targeted around end-December or early January. Alumina spot realisation is improving, with H2 average realisation guided at about INR35,000/t versus INR33,200/t in H1, while Middle East shipping disruption has cut export dispatches.

financial_highlights.metric: H1 power and fuel cost increase
financial_highlights.change: YoY, of which fuel oil/refinery INR256 crore and purchased power INR73 crore
Year-end FY27 expected to be about INR12,000 crore
FY27 capex plan above INR1,800 crore

segments.name: Alumina
segments.commentary: H1 average realisation INR33,200/t, guided to about INR35,000/t in H2; export spot tenders around $370-380/t expected. Alumina cost guided flat in H2 with caustic soda rising about INR2,000/t, offset by efficiency gains of INR400-500/t. Alumina production full-year guidance about 2.45 Mt.

segments.name: Aluminium
segments.commentary: Metal pricing linked to LME with about 95% domestic customers under annual MOUs; LME assumed around INR3,000 for the annual plan. No hedging under company policy.

segments.name: Captive coal (Utkal)
segments.commentary: H1 production about 2.1 Mt (21 lakh tonnes). FY27 target 4.8 Mt versus about 4 Mt in FY26; environmental clearance for 4.8 Mt pending with MoEFCC, expected in about two months.

guidance_outlook: 5th Stream refinery: mechanical completion of remaining packages, integrated trials and production start targeted around last week of December or early January; ramp-up to full capacity over 3-5 months; about 0.75-0.8 Mt output next year versus 1 Mt rated.

H2 FY27 alumina cost expected similar to H1, with caustic soda rising about INR2,000/t (about INR500-600/t cost impact) offset by lower caustic consumption, reduced HFO/LDO use and techno-economic gains of at least INR100 crore.
Alumina spot realisation guided to about $370-380/t, with management not expecting more than about $350-400 range in the longer term; H2 realisation about INR35,000/t.
Full-year alumina production about 2.45 Mt; 5th Stream expected to add about 0.15 Mt in the period after start.

Brownfield smelter (Angul): EGA technology licence signed; DPR and board approval expected around February 2027; INR17,000-18,000 crore investment; package ordering by December 2027; mechanical completion targeted December 2030 and commissioning from Q1 FY31. Major capex from FY28-29; power plant JV with NLC (50:50) pending board approval.
Cash balance expected at about INR12,000 crore at FY27 year-end; FY27 capex to exceed INR1,800 crore with H2 weighted due to EGA payments.
Pay revision expected to affect only January-March 2027 in FY27; management cited at least 15% wage increase as a likely trend.
capex_capacity: 5th Stream refinery (alumina) in final mechanical completion, about 90% physical completion on critical packages; integrated trials targeted late December 2026 or early January 2027.

Brownfield smelter at Angul: DPR due January-February 2027, board approval around February 2027, land acquisition February-March 2027, groundwork from January-February 2028, commissioning from Q1 FY31; investment about INR25,000 crore including power plant.
Utkal coal block: FY27 target 4.8 Mt; H1 output about 2.1 Mt; environmental clearance for 4.8 Mt under process.

Pottangi bauxite mine: MDO Dilip Buildcon appointed; mining start delayed by tree felling and local resistance, expected to be resolved in 2-3 months; about 18 km conveyor planned in 2-2.5 years at about INR1,000 crore.
Red mud filtration unit: INR400-500 crore investment, about INR20-100/t cost impact.
demand_pricing: Export alumina shipments normally about four vessels per month (about 120,000 t per shipment); October 2026 dispatch fell to one vessel due to Strait of Hormuz disruption; about six vessels targeted for November 2026, with two loaded and three paid.
Caustic soda: FY26 average about INR42,000/t, H1 FY27 about INR46,900-47,000/t, Q3 projection about INR49,000/t.
CP coke: FY26 average INR44,600/t, H1 FY27 INR63,700/t, Q3 projection INR70,600/t.
LDO/HFO prices up about 15%; LDO from about INR84,800/t in H1 to around INR1,20,000/t.
Bauxite cost about INR1,300-1,400/t from Panchpatmali; Pottangi ore to carry about INR490-500/t extra road transport until conveyor commissioning.
Alumina cost of production about $250/t per management's estimate; domestic alumina priced off export spot tender averages plus import duty.

qa_highlights.question: Status of 5th Stream refinery, Pottangi mines and Utkal coal expansion?
qa_highlights.answer: Refinery packages largely complete with integrated trials and production start targeted late December or early January; Pottangi mining delayed by tree felling and local resistance, expected to resolve in 2-3 months; Utkal FY27 target 4.8 Mt pending environmental clearance.

qa_highlights.question: Will H2 margins hold at Q2 levels?
qa_highlights.answer: Management confirmed stable margins for H2 citing refinery start (about INR150 crore PBT benefit), techno-economic gains (at least INR100 crore) and absence of the one-off royalty impact (about INR300-350 crore total uplift expected in H2).

qa_highlights.question: Why did power and fuel costs rise in H1?
qa_highlights.answer: Rail rake diversion to integrated power plants cut coal supply, leaving coal stock at 1-2 days versus 15-day norm; moisture forced heavy fuel oil use (INR256 crore) and purchased power rose INR73 crore after captive power plant breakdowns.

qa_highlights.question: How much will input costs inflate in H2 and FY28?
qa_highlights.answer: H2 costs expected at H1 levels or lower; input price inflation about 2-4% per year and employee cost impact from the pay revision from FY28; management expects margins to be maintained over the next 3-4 years.

qa_highlights.question: Outlook for alumina prices and Middle East and Indonesian supply?
qa_highlights.answer: Expected spot prices around $370-380/t, not above about $350-400; excess supply of about 1.6 Mt in the market and new Indonesian and Vedanta capacity add pressure, partly offset by smelter restarts in the Middle East.

qa_highlights.question: Coal sourcing and FSA exposure?
qa_highlights.answer: FSA for about 6 Mt covers smelter needs; e-auction coal fell to 1.96 lakh t in H1 FY27 from 5.16 lakh t in FY26, with linkage coal and Utkal coal replacing it.

risks_watch: Strait of Hormuz disruption and export vessel availability: October 2026 dispatches fell to one vessel versus four per month normal.
Pottangi mine start depends on resolving tree felling, public hearing for land (80-100 of 132 acres) and local resistance; conveyor target 2-2.5 years.
Refinery start slippage beyond January 2027 would delay alumina volume gains and the 0.75-0.8 Mt next-year output estimate.
Pay commission outcome for FY27 Q4 and FY28 (management cited at least 15%).
Utkal environmental clearance for 4.8 Mt, expected in about two months.
Captive power plant breakdowns and coal moisture/stock levels in monsoon season.
Royalty and lease renewal for Panchpatmali (South Block lease 2031) may bring additional royalty per management.
summary.management_tone: Confident on H1 results and on the 5th Stream and smelter timelines, but cautious on alumina pricing and shipping, with repeated references to geopolitical dependence. Several answers were loose or conflicting on figures (e.g. alumina production, cash and capex), so some numbers need confirmation against the filings.

adds.what: 5th Stream alumina refinery, 1 Mt rated (about 0.15 Mt added in period after start; FY27 output ~1.5 lakh t)
Utkal captive coal output ramp to 4.8 Mt FY27 target (existing mine, output expansion pending 4.8 Mt environmental clearance)
Brownfield aluminium smelter at Angul (EGA technology licence; DPR and board approval ~Feb 2027; INR17,000-18,000 crore per guidance)

growth.why: No explicit revenue growth guidance; H2 alumina realisation guided to about INR35,000/t vs INR33,200/t in H1 (~5% uplift), with alumina FY27 production ~2.45 Mt (cut from prior 2.4-2.5 framing per call) and 5th Stream adding only ~0.15 Mt in FY27, while Middle East shipping disruption cut export dispatches.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Management confirmed H2 margins stable at Q2 levels, citing refinery start (about INR150 crore PBT benefit), techno-economic gains of at least INR100 crore and a one-off royalty absence worth about INR300-350 crore in H2, though H2 alumina cost is flat and caustic soda rises about INR2,000/t (INR500-600/t impact).

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: 5th Stream refinery (1 Mt rated) is about 90% physically complete with integrated trials late Dec 2026 or early Jan 2027, adding about 0.15 Mt in FY27 (~1.5 lakh t), and Utkal coal targets 4.8 Mt in FY27 versus about 2.1 Mt in H1.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Alumina FY27 guidance is about 2.45 Mt with the refinery adding only ~0.15 Mt, while Hormuz disruption cut October export dispatches to one vessel versus about four per month normal, so volume upside depends on shipping recovery.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Brownfield Angul smelter (EGA licence signed, INR17,000-18,000 crore per guidance, or about INR25,000 crore including power plant) has DPR due Jan-Feb 2027 and board approval around Feb 2027; H1 capex was about INR800 crore against a FY27 plan above INR1,800 crore.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: H2 alumina realisation guided to about INR35,000/t versus INR33,200/t in H1 (about 5% uplift) and spot tenders at $370-380/t, but management sees a longer-term range of $350-400/t with about 1.6 Mt excess supply in the market.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Refinery start slippage beyond January 2027, Pottangi mine delay of 2-3 months from tree felling and local resistance, and Utkal 4.8 Mt pending environmental clearance (about two months) all create risk to FY27 volume targets; alumina production guidance already cut framing around 2.45 Mt.

rows.label: Alumina spot realisation uplift in H2
rows.why: H2 average realisation guided at about INR35,000/t versus INR33,200/t in H1, with spot tenders at $370-380/t.

rows.label: Techno-economic gains and lower HFO/LDO use
rows.why: Management guides techno-economic gains of at least INR100 crore and efficiency gains of INR400-500/t in alumina, offsetting caustic soda rise of about INR2,000/t.

rows.label: Utkal environmental clearance for 4.8 Mt
rows.why: Environmental clearance for 4.8 Mt coal output is pending with MoEFCC and expected in about two months, enabling the FY27 target versus about 2.1 Mt in H1.

tone.note: Management was confident on H1 results, the 5th Stream refinery start and smelter timelines, but cautious on alumina pricing, Middle East shipping and input costs; analysts pushed on alumina production guidance, cash and capex figures, which management answered loosely and need confirmation against
